title: MarsNav - NASA Space Apps 2026 - Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map

captions.text:
The first crew on Mars will walk
with no GPS, and limited air.
MarsNav keeps a way home on every step.
It ranks landing sites and science targets,

then plans each walk on NASA terrain
down to one metre.

From habitat to helmet,
it reads the suit and re-plans.

Perseverance took 85 sols
to make this trip.

For a crew, MarsNav plans it
as an 84-minute walk.

In 40 simulated EVAs,
no crew touched their reserve.
MarsNav. Every step, a way home.
